issues.title: Legacy config alias keys are accepted on load but normalized on save
symptoms: Older alias keys such as EnableMorphCharges can still be read from config.
After saving through current code, the config is written back with canonical key names instead of the old alias names.
workarounds: Use the canonical keys: enableMorphChargeSystem, enableSoulJarSystem, enablePermanentMorphs, enableSoulAbsorption.

issues.title: deathMorphRule is not currently part of identity2.json
symptoms: deathMorphRule exists in IdentitySettings but is not loaded or saved by the current JSON config manager.
Support staff may not find a matching key in config/identity2.json.
workarounds: No supported JSON config key is present in current code.
Treat deathMorphRule as code-only until the mod author confirms a supported config path.

issues.title: Older builds could show stale or empty unlock caches after respawn
symptoms: Unlocks could appear to reset after death or respawn even though the server still had the data.
The morph UI could show an empty or stale unlock list after respawn.
